FY2022 restated revenue 41,876, inventory 24,943, staff 6,216, depreciation 944, other net operating 7,716, trading profit 2,057, dividend income 635, interest received 388, finance costs 887, impairment 455, reversal 614, loss allowances -52, profit on sale and dilution 394, profit before tax 2,798, taxation 757, share of after tax profit of equity accounted investments 10,786, discontinued operations 2,152, net profit 14,979, non-controlling 1,840, attributable 13,139. Mapping: Cost of Sales is inventory expenses, Gross Profit is revenue less inventory expenses, Operating Expenses is staff costs plus depreciation plus other net operating expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed trading profit, Net Finance Costs is finance costs less interest received and is therefore negative where interest received exceeds finance costs. Net Profit is the attributable figure, which is what the EPS row is computed on. The identity that holds in this structure is profit before tax less taxation plus share of after tax profit of equity accounted investments plus the non-controlling interest equals attributable net profit; profit before tax less taxation alone does not equal it because Remgro consolidates equity accounted results below the taxation line, exactly as the previously stored FY2024 column did. The stored FY2022 to FY2025 rows above the tax line were a secondary feed mix that did not reproduce the audited statements (FY2025 revenue was carried as 52,989 against the audited 51,506 and FY2024 operating profit as 364 against the audited trading profit 2,683); they are replaced by the audited figures here. Ratios recomputed from these rows and from the balance sheet already in this dataset.
